name: Scheduler
descr: The scheduler of the program: the tasks and the feed of notes under every one of them - the same lists the owner and the staff see in their windows. Add-only, the way the program keeps it: a task is never edited nor deleted, it moves by a note carrying a state, and kClose ends it. A private task is seen by its author, its executor and the person with id 1. state_key and kind_key are values of TASK_STATE_KEY and TASK_KIND_KEY in the base settings, and the people go by id - the Users tool answers them.

commands.name: CmdList
commands.descr: Reads every task this person may see, the closed ones too - kClose tells them apart - and counts the notes of each, so a feed is asked for knowingly.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Adds a task and opens its feed with the first note, the way the program opens one. The person of this session signs as the author, and the state at birth is kNew.

params.name: name
params.descr: one line of what to do

params.name: exec_id
params.descr: id of the person the task goes to

params.name: content
params.descr: the text of the first note of the feed

commands.name: CmdNoteList
commands.descr: Reads the feed of a task whole, the notes in the order they were written.

params.name: task_id
params.descr: id of the task, or several of them

commands.name: CmdNoteAdd
commands.descr: Writes a note into the feed of one task; the state says whether the task moves with it - kComment leaves it where it stands, any other state moves it and kClose ends it. exec_id, kind_key and privy given here move with the task.

params.name: state_key
params.descr: a value of TASK_STATE_KEY; kComment moves nothing

params.name: exec_id
params.descr: the person the task goes to now, when it moves

params.name: kind_key
params.descr: the kind of the task now, when it moves

params.name: privy
params.descr: true - the task turns private, when it moves
